#!/bin/sh
set -eu
operation="$HOME/.local/share/ji-host/operations/install-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT-28da2413f1ceabc7"
printf 'actual_sha256='; sha256sum "$operation/actual-files" | cut -d' ' -f1
printf 'expected_sha256='; sha256sum "$operation/expected-files" | cut -d' ' -f1
if cmp -s "$operation/actual-files" "$operation/expected-files"; then
  printf '%s\n' INVENTORY_MATCH
else
  printf '%s\n' INVENTORY_MISMATCH
  cmp -l "$operation/actual-files" "$operation/expected-files" | head -n 8 || true
fi
